primary_sources.title: Statistical Inference, Chapter 3, Example 3.4
primary_sources.use: Author-written account of classical exponential-rate unbiased estimation. The four-wait gamma identity is rederived completely; no novelty claimed for it.

primary_sources.title: On Tail Probabilities for Martingales
primary_sources.use: Classical martingale Bernstein/Freedman lineage. The exact bounded-increment inequality needed here is proved directly, including constants.

primary_sources.authors: Emilie Kaufmann; Olivier Cappe; Aurelien Garivier
primary_sources.title: On the Complexity of Best-Arm Identification in Multi-Armed Bandit Models
primary_sources.use: Sequential change-of-measure method. The controlled continuous-time local-exposure bound is separately derived for this physical observation model.

comparison_scope: The finite interface is the combined arithmetic averaging, actual context observations, finite censor/timer error accounting, repeated-cell conditional confidence, and matched same-access exposure bound. An ordinary method using these same grouped observations and martingale machinery can attain the same statistical scaling. There is no claimed advantage over every conceivable estimator.
